title: Studio: a dashboard draft whose requiredPermissions the author does not hold reads 403, Studio treats that as "no draft", and the next autosave overwrites the draft without the key
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE

Filing gate: ① a product defect, found beside the clauses (studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save), reach: the Studio autosave, measured twice.
Business reason: a dashboard draft can carry an audience gate (`requiredPermissions`) that its author does not hold, for example one written over the API or MCP by another author. When that author opens it in Studio, Studio shows "Draft · 1 unpublished" but edits the published body, and the next autosave replaces the draft without the gate and without If-Match. Publishing then serves the dashboard to everyone: the gate fails open, and every other draft-only change is lost too. This is the data loss the item's negative[0] forbids. It is not an authorization hole: the author is a metadata writer on their own package.
Reader who acts: the triage seat, then a `domain:ui` implementer in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` and `studio-design/`. QA suggestion only: `area:studio`, p2.
Duplicate search: `readDraftForSave` → 6 hits; #26837 (closed, a permission-set save dropping other doors' values) is the nearest and a different path; `requiredPermissions draft 403 Studio dashboard` → 34 hits, none about this.
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1 — 16 cards from QA run #29002 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

## Reproduction
1. A writable package PKG with a published dashboard D (one metric widget, no requiredPermissions).
2. As admin: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/D?mode=draft&package=PKG` with the published body plus `"requiredPermissions":["showcase.export_data"]` (a capability the admin holds through no set) → 200 draft.
3. `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/D?state=draft&package=PKG` → 403 PERMISSION_DENIED "You do not have permission to open the 'D' dashboard." (by design, `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`).
4. Form sign-in → `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces` → D in the Dashboards rail. The header shows "Draft · 1 unpublished"; the canvas shows the published body (network: the draft read 403, then `/layers` 200).
5. Edit the Label and wait 2 s.

Expected: Studio refuses to edit a draft it cannot read, or keeps the draft's keys; at least it never overwrites it unpinned. Actual: `PUT …/dashboard/D?mode=draft&package=PKG&surface=studio` → 200 with no `requiredPermissions` and no If-Match; the draft read afterwards has no gate. Reproduced 2 of 2 on fresh loads.

## Mechanism (suspected)
`readDraftForSave` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DraftConflictDialog.tsx` catches any draft-read failure (403 included) and answers "no pending draft", so `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (leaf load, about L5186–5216) seeds the leaf from the layered baseline and the save goes out with no pin.

QA-source: #29002 · studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save · observed beside the clauses
